info.title: Stabilizer API
info.description:
OpenAPI source for the Stabilizer v1 API.
This specification covers the public routes, organization-scoped developer routes,
and extraction runtime routes.

200.description: Sorted list of approved model IDs.
API keys for the current organization.

201.description: Newly created key. The raw key value is returned once.

get.summary: Get API key summary (with live budget usage)
get.description: {key_id} accepts the literal 'me'. A key may read its own summary at any scope; reading another key requires a 'full' key.

patch.description: Marketplace lifecycle: upgrade, suspend (extract_limit 0), or offboard (revoked). Requires a 'full' key. {key_id} accepts 'me'.

200.description: LLM configs for the current org.

post.description: Verify that a BYOK provider API key authenticates before saving it in a config. Performs one minimal authenticated request to the provider and reports whether the key was accepted. Persists nothing.

api_key.description: The provider API key to verify.

default_model.description: Optional model to probe with; defaults to a known model.

base_url.description: Optional provider base URL; defaults to OpenRouter.

200.description: Validation result. `valid` is true when the provider accepted the key.

post.description:
Creates an asynchronous compile job.
Returns `202 Accepted` with a job ID.

200.description: Function metadata without internal compiled prompts.

post.description: Creates an asynchronous prompt optimization job.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at (half-open [from, to)).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at (half-open [from, to)).

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Set to 'key' for per-key bulk usage (UsageByKey). Requires a 'full' key.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max keys per page for group_by=key (default 200).

get.description: Bare call returns the org aggregate. With ?group_by=key returns bulk UsageByKey (one entry per key; requires a 'full' key). from/to are half-open [from, to) on created_at.
PerKeyUsage over a half-open [from, to) window. {key_id} accepts 'me' (self-serve gate). Reading another key requires a 'full' key. With no from/to a budgeted key defaults to its current period.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on created_at (ISO-8601 UTC).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on created_at (ISO-8601 UTC).

bearerAuth.description: Organization-scoped Stabilizer API key sent as an Authorization Bearer token.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer key.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but not authorized for the requested scope.

ValidationError.description: Request body or request parameters failed validation.

QuotaExhausted.description: Session quota for compile or extract was exhausted.

last_used_at.description: created_at of the key's most recent job, or null.

metadata.description: Free-form; echoed back in usage (e.g. tenant_id, marketplace_subscription_id).

default_model.description: Model used at extraction time only. Compile is governed by `compile_strength`.

compile_strength.description: Base-model strength tier used for compile and inherited as the default for grounding at extraction time. Defaults to `low` if absent.

default_model.description: Model used at extraction time only. Compile is governed by `compile_strength`.

compile_strength.description: Base-model strength tier used for compile and inherited as the default for grounding at extraction time.

default_model.description: Model used at extraction time only. Compile is governed by `compile_strength`.

compile_strength.description: Base-model strength tier used for compile and inherited as the default for grounding at extraction time.

Base-model strength tier to use for this compile. Overrides the LLM config's `compile_strength`. The server resolves the tier to a concrete provider/model server-side; clients never select a model directly. Sending the legacy `compile_model` field returns HTTP 400.

extraction_model.description: Model used for baseline extraction only (when `run_baseline_extraction` is true). Independent of grounding, which is governed by `grounding_strength`.

grounding_strength.description: Base-model strength tier for the grounding wrapper. Defaults to the compiled function's stored compile strength, then to the LLM config's `compile_strength`, then to `low`.

grounding_methods.description: Overrides the grounding method list saved at compile time for this run only. Public aliases (e.g. `hard_grounding`, `coverage_check`, `stress_test`). The mandatory runtime guards are always applied on top. Ignored when `minimal_run` is true.

minimal_run.description: Cheapest possible run. Forces no grounding methods at all, a single extraction (no variations), and no baseline extraction. Overrides `grounding_methods`, `num_results`, and `run_baseline_extraction`.

run_baseline_extraction.description: Also run a single raw extraction with the prompt as-is, without Stabilizer scoring or prompt variations.

Budget.description: Live budget block for a key (current period).

reset_at.description: Start of the next period (ISO-8601 UTC); null for period 'total'.

BudgetInput.description: Per-period extract budget. Omit for an unlimited key.

extract_limit.description: Billable extract jobs per period. 0 suspends the key (hard-stops via 429).

cycle_anchor.description: Required for period 'billing_cycle': day-of-month (1-28) or an ISO date whose day is used.

ApiKeyPatchRequest.description: Lifecycle update: raise/lower/suspend the budget, edit metadata, or revoke.

budget.description: Replace the budget; null clears it (unlimited).

PerKeyUsage.description: Per-key usage over a half-open [from, to) window on created_at. extract_count is billable (succeeded) extractions only.

UsageByKey.description: Bulk per-key usage - one entry per key, cursor-paginated by key_id.
